abilities.desc_zh: 威震天总会回来的。当生命值降至10%以下时，威震天将在3秒内恢复最大生命值的30%。//每局只触发一次，如果敌方的致命攻击一次性造成10%以上的伤害，该技能不触发，威震天直接被KO。
abilities.desc_en:
All Hail Megaton!
Megatron always comes back. Regenerates Health when almost dead.
Passive: Megatron always comes back. When Health drops below {{var_9}}, Megatron Repairs {{var_10}} of his base Health over {{var_11}}.
+about {{var_12}} per level.
Overpower - Opponents are relegated to insignificant underlings.

abilities.desc_zh: 技能结束后，增加远程攻击速度和40%的远程伤害，持续6秒  // 不命中也可以

abilities.title_zh: 敌人 – 擎天柱 (MV1)、大黄蜂 (DOTM)
abilities.desc_en: Enemies – Optimus Prime (MV1), Bumblebee (DOTM) - {{var_17}}~{{var_18}} Attack Rating.

abilities.title_zh: 锻造领先——研磨机、碎骨机、路障
abilities.title_en: Forged to Lead – Grindor, Bonecrusher, Barricade
abilities.desc_zh: 威震天的每个爪牙都为他提供了独特的能力。作为回报，威震天为每个机器人提供 {{var_19}}~{{var_20}} 装甲。
abilities.desc_en: Forged to Lead – Grindor, Bonecrusher, Barricade - Megatron’s minions each provide him with a unique ability. In return Megatron provides {{var_19}}~{{var_20}} Armor to each bot.

abilities.desc_zh: 威震天有 {{var_21}}~{{var_22}} 机会开始战斗不可阻挡。
abilities.desc_en: Forged to Serve – Grindor - Megatron has a {{var_21}}~{{var_22}} chance to begin the fight Unstoppable.

abilities.desc_zh: 当敌人达到 20 个削弱球时，威震天将获得 {{var_23}}~{{var_24}} 几率击晕敌人。
abilities.desc_en: Forged to Serve – Bonecrusher - Megatron gains a {{var_23}}~{{var_24}} chance to Stun an enemy when they reach 20 Impair Charges.

abilities.desc_zh: 威震天有 {{var_25}}~{{var_26}} 几率每次击中造成 2 个损伤球。
abilities.desc_en: Forged to Serve – Barricade - Megatron has a {{var_25}}~{{var_26}} chance to inflict 2 Impair Charges per hit.

abilities.desc_zh: 作为领导力的灯塔，所有较低级别的队友都会获得 +{{var_27}} 特殊伤害。
abilities.desc_en: Acting as a beacon of Leadership, all lower tiers teammate gain +{{var_27}} Special Damage.

abilities.desc_zh: 您团队中的所有霸天虎在与霸天虎战斗时获得 +{{var_28}}~{{var_29}} 装甲值，在与汽车人战斗时获得 +{{var_30}}~{{var_31}} 功率率。
abilities.desc_en: All Decepticons on your team gain +{{var_28}}~{{var_29}} Armor while fighting Decepticons and +{{var_30}}~{{var_31}} Power Rate while fighting Autobots.

abilities.desc_zh: +10%的永久护甲增益，无图标，不可被破甲移除
abilities.desc_en: This bot’s naturally tough Cybertronian exterior provides a permanent {{var_8}} passive Armor Buff.

abilities.desc_zh: 当生命值降至80%/60%/40%时，获得不可阻挡增益，持续4秒
abilities.desc_en: Character's movement cannot be interrupted by opponent's attacks

abilities.desc_zh: 如果在不可阻挡状态发动重击未命中，获得一个40%的攻击增益，持续10秒
abilities.desc_en: When Knocking Down Opponents: Gains a permanent Attack Buff, increasing Attack by {{var_5}}. The bigger the size of the opponent, the larger the Attack bonus. (Max: 15 stacks)

abilities.desc_zh: 所有攻击（含特殊技）命中时，给对手施加一层伤害电荷，出于重击和SP3消耗 //红色图标，无倒计时，可叠加

重击命中时，每1层伤害电荷增加5%的暴击几率。
如果重击出暴击，将消耗所有的伤害电荷，每1层电荷增加2%的暴击伤害

第一击施加20层伤害电荷。每1层伤害电荷增加5%的暴击几率。
由于仅SP3施加的伤害电荷已将暴击几率拉满至100%，故最后一击必然暴击，每1层电荷增加2%的暴击伤害
abilities.desc_en: Overpower - Opponents are relegated to insignificant underlings.

abilities.desc_zh: 进攻动作无视对手攻击冲击与受击打断。
abilities.desc_en: Shrugs off hit reactions; attacks cannot be interrupted.

abilities.desc_zh: 临时增加远程攻击的速度、射击频率与伤害。
abilities.desc_en: Temporarily increases ranged attack speed and damage.
